lines.text: Your coding agent runs on the beefy computer at home. You are on a train, and you want to see what it is doing.
Normally that means a remote desktop, a vpn, or an ssh session you set up months ago.
Install the Agent R Q D daemon on any computer you own. It is a small program that runs quietly.
Enrol it once with a single-use code, and it shows up in Agent R Q as a machine.
Each machine is listed with its name and status, so you know what is online before you tap.
From any browser, start a coding agent on that machine, in the repository you choose.
Then watch its live terminal, line by line, as the agent works.
And you can type into the terminal, not just watch, so you can steer the agent from your seat.
Even the escape key works, so you can interrupt the agent the moment it heads the wrong way.
Laptop, server, a box under the desk. All of them live in one list.
It is like being at the desk, from a train, a sofa, or a cafe.
Where do your agents run today? Tell us, or add a machine at Agent R Q dot com.
